description: Audit of all 17 deposited mammalian Arc structures: observed residue coverage, chain counts, and which determinants have no coordinates
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, os
OUT="/agent/jobs/8702c639-95bf-4148-bbca-ab3e5442c5e6/provenance"
META={'26AP':('human',1.50,2026),'6TN7':('human',1.67,2020),'6TNQ':('human',1.30,2021),'6TQ0':('human',1.95,2021),
 '6YTU':('human',0.95,2021),'7R1Z':('human',1.94,2022),'7R23':('human',2.77,2022),'8QF4':('human',1.02,2024),
 '8QF5':('human',1.50,2024),'9PZZ':('human',1.56,2026),'9Q00':('human',2.84,2026),'4X3H':('rat',2.40,2015),
 '4X3I':('rat',1.80,2015),'4X3X':('rat',2.00,2015),'6GSE':('rat',np.nan,2019),'7R24':('rat',2.70,2022),
 '6TNO':('human',1.90,2020)}
rows=[]
for pid,(org,res,yr) in META.items():
    txt=requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.pdb",timeout=120).text.splitlines()
    ch={}
    for l in txt:
        if l.startswith("ENDMDL"): break
        if l.startswith("ATOM"): ch.setdefault(l[21],set()).add(int(l[22:26]))
    arc={c:r for c,r in ch.items() if len(r)>=25 and min(r)>=95 and max(r)<=400}
    if not arc: print("no Arc chain found in",pid); continue
    obs=set().union(*arc.values())
    rows.append(dict(pdb=pid,organism=org,resolution_A=res,year=yr,n_arc_chains=len(arc),
                     arc_first=min(obs),arc_last=max(obs),n_arc_residues_observed=len(obs)))
inv=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values(["arc_first","pdb"])
print(inv.to_string(index=False))
inv.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"arc_structure_inventory.csv"),index=False)
print("\nmax Arc chains in any single deposited entry:",inv.n_arc_chains.max())

cov=np.zeros(398,int)
chains_per_res=np.zeros(398,int)
for pid,(org,res,yr) in META.items():
    sub=inv[inv.pdb==pid]
    if not len(sub): continue
    r=sub.iloc[0]
    cov[r.arc_first:r.arc_last+1]+=1
uncov=[i for i in range(1,397) if cov[i]==0]
def runs(x):
    if not x: return []
    out=[];s=p=x[0]
    for v in x[1:]:
        if v!=p+1: out.append((s,p)); s=v
        p=v
    out.append((s,p)); return out
print("Arc residues with no coverage in any deposited structure:",runs(uncov))
print("uncovered: %d of 396 (%.0f%%)"%(len(uncov),100*len(uncov)/396))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,8.2),gridspec_kw=dict(height_ratios=[2.6,1]),sharex=True)
a=ax[0]
cols={'human':'#2b6cb0','rat':'#38a169'}
for i,(_,r) in enumerate(inv.iterrows()):
    a.barh(i,r.arc_last-r.arc_first+1,left=r.arc_first,height=0.62,color=cols[r.organism])
    a.text(r.arc_last+4,i,f"{r.n_arc_chains} chain"+("s" if r.n_arc_chains>1 else ""),va="center",fontsize=8,color="#444")
a.set_yticks(range(len(inv)))
a.set_yticklabels([f"{r.pdb} ({r.organism}, {r.year})" for _,r in inv.iterrows()],fontsize=8.5)
for x0,x1,lab,c in [(1,88,"1-88 never observed","#feb2b2"),(133,205,"133-205 never observed","#feb2b2"),(371,396,"371-396 never observed","#feb2b2")]:
    a.axvspan(x0,x1,color=c,alpha=0.45,zorder=0)
a.set_xlim(0,400); a.invert_yaxis()
a.set_title("A. Every deposited mammalian Arc structure is a fragment: no entry contains more than 8 Arc chains",fontsize=10.5)
a.legend(handles=[plt.Line2D([],[],color=cols['human'],lw=7,label='human Q7LC44'),
                  plt.Line2D([],[],color=cols['rat'],lw=7,label='rat Q63053'),
                  plt.Line2D([],[],color="#feb2b2",lw=7,label='no coordinates in any entry')],
         fontsize=8,loc="lower right")
b=ax[1]
b.fill_between(range(1,397),cov[1:397],step="mid",color="#4a5568")
for x0,x1 in [(89,100),(195,214)]: b.axvspan(x0,x1,color="#d69e2e",alpha=0.55)
b.axvspan(99,132,color="#2b6cb0",alpha=0.30)
b.set_ylabel("number of entries\ncovering the residue"); b.set_xlabel("Arc residue number (396 aa)")
b.set_title("B. Coverage depth. Orange: endophilin determinant 89-100 and dynamin determinant 195-214. Blue: NT coil 99-132",fontsize=10)
b.set_xlim(0,400)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
